    std::string s;
    int n;
    
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int maxOutside = 0, maxInside = 0;
    int currentLen = 0;
    bool insideParen = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        
        if (ch == '(') {
            if (currentLen > 0) {
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
            }
            currentLen = 0;
            insideParen = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            if (currentLen > 0) {
                maxInside++;
            }
            currentLen = 0;
            insideParen = false;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (insideParen) {
                if (currentLen > 0) {
                    maxInside++;
                }
                currentLen = 0;
            } else {
                if (currentLen > 0) {
                    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
                }
                currentLen = 0;
            }
        } else {
            currentLen++;
        }
    }
    
    if (currentLen > 0) {
        maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
    }
    
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << maxInside << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
